configurations.name: Debug Current Package
configurations.comment: Debugs the current package. Automatically detects if it's a program or test. Use when debugging from within a package directory (e.g., minis/07-generic-lru-cache/cmd/... or internal/...). This configuration works contextually - it will debug the package containing the currently open file.

configurations.name: Debug Tests (Current Package)
configurations.comment: Runs tests in the current package with debugger support. Use when debugging tests from within an exercise package (e.g., internal/<pkg>/). Set breakpoints in test functions or exercise.go files, then use F10 (Step Over) and F11 (Step Into) to debug.
